output.content: I checked the nightly ingest logs for the till scan lines from the northern region stores. The pipeline receives the files and moves them straight into the raw storage bucket. There is no validation step between the arrival of the file and its availability for the forecast job. The records land in the target table exactly as they appear in the source files. I sampled a batch from last Tuesday and found entries with negative unit counts and missing store identifiers. The system accepted these rows without flagging them. The next scheduled run picked them up and passed them along to the feature store. The infrastructure handled the volume without error, but it did not inspect the content of the individual scan lines for structural consistency before writing them to disk.
